decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The proposed
first floor side extension, in conjunction with the existing gable end, would
result in a discordant and ungainly cumulative addition to the dwelling and would
fail to meet the high quality design aspirations of the National Planning
Policy Framework (2024). The proposal is also contrary to Policy D3.D (1) and (11) of the
London Plan (2021), Core Strategy Policy CSB (2012), Policy DM1 of the Harrow
Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the adopted Harrow
Supplementary Planning Document Residential Design Guide (2010) and GR1 of the Draft Harrow Local Plan 2021-2041.<font face="Aptos, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The proposed
development is located within surface water flood zone 3a and 3b and fluvial
flood zone 3 (high) and 2 (medium) in the absence of a satisfactory Flood Risk
Assessment, it has not been demonstrated that the proposed development would
not exacerbate the risk of flooding within the site or increase the risk and
consequences of flooding elsewhere, contrary to National Planning Policy
Framework (2024), Policy SI 12 of The London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1.U of
the Harrow Core Strategy (2012) and Policies DM9 and DM10 of the Harrow
Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).<font face="Aptos, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>
description: Single storey front extension incorporating porch; Conversion of garage to habitable room; First floor side extension; Single and two storey rear extension; Roof light in front roof slope; External alterations (Demolition of front entrance canopy)
